# Twent Docs

> Step-by-step guides for Twent AI agent on Android — automate apps, run Ubuntu terminal & connect 1000+ services.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://twent.xyz/docs): Twent is a free AI agent for Android — it automates apps, runs an Ubuntu terminal, connects to MCP servers and skills. BYOK.

## Changelog

- [v1.0.0](https://twent.xyz/docs/changelog/v1-0-0): Public docs refresh: Blume upgraded to v1.4.3 with full AEO, search, and agent-readability enabled.

## Features

- [Agent Capabilities](https://twent.xyz/docs/features/agent-capabilities): What your Twent agent can do out of the box — web research and persistent memory.
- [Agent CLIs](https://twent.xyz/docs/features/agent-clis): Browse and install AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Hermes Agent inside Twent's Ubuntu terminal.
- [Token Config](https://twent.xyz/docs/features/token-config): Get API keys for any AI provider without leaving the Twent app.
- [Terminal](https://twent.xyz/docs/features/terminal): A full Ubuntu Linux computer inside Twent, with automatic first-time setup.
- [Bots](https://twent.xyz/docs/features/bots): Twent agents with a specific task, triggered manually, on a schedule, by webhook, or by MCP events.
- [Subagents](https://twent.xyz/docs/features/subagents): The Twent agent can delegate subagents to do tasks in parallel.
- [AI Content/Media Generation](https://twent.xyz/docs/features/ai-media-generation): Point Twent at your favorite AI media tools — it drives them for you to generate images, videos, audio, music, and 3D models.

## Getting Started

- [Start Using Twent](https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/start-using-twent): Download the Twent APK, install it on your Android phone, grant permissions, connect an AI provider, and finish setup — step by step.

## Legal

- [Data Deletion Instructions](https://twent.xyz/docs/legal/data-deletion): App Name: **Twent**

## More

- [Memory](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/memory): Persistent knowledge storage that survives across conversations, editable in the AI's Memory page.
- [Settings](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/settings): Deep customization — every aspect of Twent is configurable.
- [Voice](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/voice): Speak to your AI and hear it respond — TTS, speech-to-text, and hands-free voice sessions.
- [Toolbox](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/toolbox): Built-in utility screens for debugging, development, and system management.
- [Tool Reference](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/tool-reference): Reference for the main built-in tools the Twent agent can call.
- [Glossary](https://twent.xyz/docs/more/glossary): Plain-English explanations of every technical term used in the Twent docs.

## Plugins

- [MCP](https://twent.xyz/docs/plugins/mcp): Connect your Twent agent to external tools with MCP servers — local, remote-hosted, or authenticated.
- [Skills](https://twent.xyz/docs/plugins/skills): Install skills to teach your Twent agent new behaviors, and call them directly with "/".
